content: Iyekiite, nokoviri naaka iravisakoshireyetai nosheninkapayeeni Israel-mirinkaite. Irootake namanantariri Pava.
Niyoperotzi naaka itharomentaventashivaitatyaari Pava irikaite, jantashivaitaro te inkemathaperotzimaityaaro.
Tema te iriyotaiyeni ikovatzi Pava irovatampatzikashiretairi, te inkempisantero, aña ikokovatashitaro intampatzikashiretantyaaro ipankiventashivaitari apaniro.
Tema iroñaaka Cristo jothotyaakero irirori okantakota Ikantakaantaitane, iriitakera tampatzikashiretakairiri ikaratzi aventaashireyetanaariri.
Jiroka okaratzi josankinavetakari Moisés-ni okantakota jimonkarayeevetaro Ikantakaantaitane intampatzikashireyeetantyaarimi, ikantake:

Tera omonkatziyaaro okantakota aventaashirenkantsi otzimi ovatampatzikashiretantatsiri. Tema te onkovaperotajaantya ipankiventashivaitaitya irimonkarayeetero tsikarika ompaitya. ¿Kantatsima irikaite pankiventashivaitachari iriyaate inkiteki ishintsiventairi Cristo irovavisaakoshiretante?
¿Kantatsima iriyaate irikaite sarinkaveniki iroviriintairi Cristo ikamavetapaintara?
Aña jiroka ikantayeetake:

content.text: Aritake piyoshiretakero ñaantsi, aritake piyothatakero eejatzi.

content: Okaratzi kantakotachari jaka “ñaantsi,” irootakera noñaaventapiintakemiri aventaashiretaarira Cristo. Jiroka okanta:
Aririka piñaanethataiyaaro pinkante, “Novinkatharite inatzi Jesús,” aririka paventaashiretanakyaari Pava iri oviriintairi ikamavetakara, aritakera pavisakoshiretai.
Tema aritakera paventaashiretaari iro kantakaantakerori irovatampatzikashireyetantairi. Aritakera añaanethataaro iroka, iroora kantakaanterone irovavisaakoshireyetantairi.
Tema ari okantzi Osankinajanorentsi:
Onkantavetakya aakarika judío, aakarika griego-thatatsiri, iriitakera Cristo Avinkathariteta maaroiteni. Intzimerika ñaañaatairine aritake ineshinonkaperotakeri.
Tema jiroka ikantaitake:

content.text: Intzimerika ñaañaatairine Pinkathari, impairyaagairi, aritake iravisakotai.

content: ¿Kantatsima iñaañaayeetairi Pava tera javentaashireyeetari? ¿Kantatsima iraventaashireyeetyaari Pava, tera inkemakotaiteri? ¿Kantatsima inkemakotaiteri, tera intzime kinkithatakaantatsine?
¿Kantatsima inkinkithatakotaiteri, tera intzime otyaantantatsine? Irootake josankinayeetantakarori, kantatsiri:

content.text: ¡Oshekira inkameethatziitataitera amerone kameethari ñaantsi isaikantaitari kameetha!

content: Iro kantamaitacha, tera maaroiteni inkempisantaitero Kameethari Ñaantsi. Irootake ikantantakari Isaías-ni:
Okovajaantatyaara iretaitavakyaaro inkemayeetavakero iñaane Pava onantyaari iraventaashireyeetantyaari.
Nokantzi naaka, “¿Aritakema ikemayeetakero?” Aritakera, tema jiroka josankinayeetakeri kantatsiri:
Napiitero nonkante, “Irikaite icharineyetakari Israel-ni, ¿Ikemathaperotakeroma?” Aña iriira Moisés-ni oñaarontakerori irosankinareki, ikantake:

content.text: Ari nonkantakaakyaaro pisamaneentyaari pashinesatzi atziriite kaari sheninkatavakaachaneri.

content: Irojatzi ikantakeri Isaías-ni irirori:
Iro kantacha jiroka jiñaaventakeri Isaías-ni ikantakota Israel-mirinkaite, ikantake:

content.text: Novaankavakotapiintashivetakari, iro kantamaitachari te inkempisantaiyenani, piyathari jinaiyakeni.
